# Connect Squarespace to an AI assistant

 Last updated October 30, 2026 17:07

#### Search for domains, get business name ideas, and work with store data in Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.

You can use Squarespace tools in the middle of a conversation with your AI assistant to get business name ideas, check whether a domain is available, and see its price. In Claude and ChatGPT, you can also work with selected store data, like contacts, orders, and products. To get started, connect Squarespace to your AI assistant.

***Also try***: [Developer Tools at Squarespace](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/41325887099533)

> You can use the Squarespace connector with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants that offer the ability to add connectors and apps. You don’t need a Squarespace account to search for domains or get name ideas. Store tools are available only in Claude and ChatGPT. To use them, you need [Administrator or Store Manager permissions](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/206537297) for the site.
>
> If you use an AI assistant through a work account, your workspace admin may need to turn on the Squarespace connector first.

## What you can do with the Squarespace connector

After you connect Squarespace, you can ask your AI assistant for help in your own words. If the assistant answers without using Squarespace, mention Squarespace in your request.

You can ask your AI assistant to:

- Suggest business names and [matching domains](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/48088156112269-Choose-a-domain-name)
- Check whether a domain is available
- Show the price of an available domain
- Share a link to buy a domain on Squarespace

## Connect Squarespace to your AI assistant

How you add Squarespace depends on your AI assistant. Most AI assistants let you add connected services in their settings, where they may be called connectors, apps, or integrations. For exact steps, visit your AI assistant’s help documentation, like [Anthropic’s guide to using connectors](https://support.claude.com/articles/11176164) or [OpenAI’s guide to apps in ChatGPT](https://help.openai.com/articles/11487775).

To connect Squarespace:

1. In your AI assistant, open the settings for connectors, apps, plugins, or integrations.
2. Search for *Squarespace*. If Squarespace isn’t listed, add a custom connector and enter this URL: https://mcp.squarespace.com/mcp
3. Click **Connect**, then follow the prompts.

## Examples of domain requests you can make in your AI assistant

Searching for domains doesn't require signing in. After connecting Squarespace to your AI assistant, you can ask:

- *Suggest five names for a ceramics business and check which .com domains are available.*
- *Is rosecityceramicsnyc.com available on Squarespace?*
- *How much does rosecityceramicsnyc.studio cost?*

## Buy a domain you found in your AI assistant

When you find a domain you want, your AI assistant can create a link to buy it. You complete the purchase from Squarespace, not in the chat, and domain prices and promotions are the same as when you buy directly from Squarespace. If your AI assistant shows a different price, the price at checkout is accurate.

To buy a domain:

1. Ask your AI assistant for a link to buy the domain.
2. Click the link to open the checkout on squarespace.com.
3. Log into your Squarespace account, or [create one](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/48088156112269).
4. Complete checkout.
5. Optional: To connect your new domain to a site or manage its settings, open your [domains dashboard](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/24115750615309).

***Also try:*** [Registering a domain without a site](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/217963508)

## Sign in to Squarespace to use store tools

Store tools are available in Claude and ChatGPT. To use them, sign in to your Squarespace account from your AI assistant. What you can do depends on your [permissions for the site](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/206537267). For example, a Store Manager can use store tools, but a Website Editor can’t.

Store tools work on one site at a time. If it’s not clear which site you mean, your AI assistant asks, then keeps using that site for the rest of the conversation. To work on a different site, ask your AI assistant to switch. If your AI assistant asks you to sign in again later, your sign-in has expired, so follow the prompts to reconnect.

To sign in:

1. In Claude or ChatGPT, ask for help with your store.
2. When prompted, log into your Squarespace account.
3. If you have more than one site, choose the site you want to use.
4. Review the permissions, then click **Connect**.

## Manage store data in Claude or ChatGPT

After you sign in to Squarespace and choose a site, you can ask Claude or ChatGPT to:

- Add or update contacts
- Look up contacts and their order history
- Review recent orders and filter them by status or date
- Update orders, like changing a shipping address or marking an order as fulfilled with tracking information
- View products, including variants and prices

## Examples of store requests you can make in Claude or ChatGPT

After you sign in to Squarespace and choose a site, you can ask:

- *Add Maya Chen to my contacts with the email address maya.chen@example.com.*
- *Show me Maya Chen’s order history.*
- *Show me all pending orders from the last seven days.*
- *Change the shipping address on order 042 to 450 Alameda Street, Denver, CO 80202, United States.*
- *Mark order 042 as fulfilled and add the UPS tracking number 1Z999AA10123456784.*
- *What sizes and colors are available for the Linen Apron, and how much does each one cost?*

## Does the connection in my AI assistant appear in Squarespace?

No. The connection lives in your AI assistant, so nothing appears in your Squarespace account or on your site. To manage or remove the connection, use your AI assistant’s settings.

Changes you make with store tools, like updating a contact, appear in Squarespace the same way as changes you make in your dashboard.

## Disconnect Squarespace from your AI assistant

You can only disconnect Squarespace in your AI assistant, not in Squarespace. To stop an AI assistant like Claude or ChatGPT from using Squarespace, remove the Squarespace connector in the assistant’s settings. For steps, visit your AI assistant’s help documentation, like [Anthropic’s guide to using connectors](https://support.claude.com/articles/11176164) or [OpenAI’s guide to apps in ChatGPT](https://help.openai.com/articles/11487775).

## Get help with the Squarespace connector

Our support team can help you connect Squarespace to Claude or ChatGPT, buy a domain, and manage your Squarespace account and store data. For your security, don't share your password, sign-in codes, or sign-in links with anyone, including our support team.

For help with your AI assistant itself, like account or subscription questions, visit its help center.

If you [contact us](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/p/contact), include:

- The AI assistant you used
- The exact error message, if you got one
- The site you connected
- What you asked your AI assistant to do
- Whether you were able to sign in
